author: Bellular News
description:
Destiny 2's final update is here, and it's the one players spent ten years asking for. Sit with that for a moment. A Destiny 3 petition is past 350,000 signatures, stream chats have turned into protest sites, and Marathon picked the worst possible week to stumble, but none of it has reached the room at PlayStation where this was decided. Because that happened months ago.
